steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: But me not say anything!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Wartface!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Shut up generals!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: What we do now Wartface?

steps.npc: Me dunno... maybe we change armour colour again.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Human, what colour you think best?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Thanks human.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Our soldiers need better weapons. We give them all warhammers!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Axes stupid! They things you cut wood with!

steps.npc: But hammers things you put nails in wood with! At least axes sharp!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: You not need sharp when you have strong goblin swinging big lump of iron!

steps.npc: Shut up human, we sort this one out ourselves!
Me tell Mudknuckles make worm stew for dinner.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Me not like worm stew! Tell him make beetle pie!

steps.npc: Beetle pie give you wind! You smell bad enough already!
Now you've solved our argument, we gotta think of something else to do.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Yep, we bored now.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: When Chosen Commander come to speak to us again?

steps.player: I don't know. I don't think she was making any progress when she spoke to you before.

steps.npc: We listen to whatever she say!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Yeah, as long as she agree with truths of Big High War God!

steps.npc: Goblins mighty, war good, Big High War God greatest god!

steps.player: I don't think Zanik is likely to say any of that.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Then she not come here again!

steps.npc: Human! Did you save chosen commander from horrible fate?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: That good. Big High War God smile on you now. You honourary goblin!

steps.npc: Last night I have vision of chosen commander. She say me biggest general, so me lead village.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: You not have vision! You make that up!

steps.npc: In my vision, chosen commander say you say that. So now I know it true.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Well... I have vision too. Chosen commander say me big general!

steps.npc: That not fair! Me have vision first!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Chosen commander also say you fat and stupid.
